asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

collapsedHeight.description: The height of the content when collapsed.

collapsedWidth.description: The width of the content when collapsed.

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the collapsible when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the collapsible.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the collapsible. Useful for composition.

onExitComplete.description: The callback invoked when the exit animation completes.

onOpenChange.description: The callback invoked when the open state changes.

open.description: The controlled open state of the collapsible.
